_readme: Default commercial policy for CustomerOps COPS-08 (approvals, subscriptions, failed-payment handling). Seed values only: load into the versioned admin config (COPS-07), never hard-code. Every value is editable by an Admin; each edit creates a new version, is audited, and running subscriptions/approvals keep the version they started under. All amounts are per-currency and are never converted implicitly.

basis._note: Where the defaults came from. Benchmarks are published vendor/agency material, not Skout's own margin data - Finance should confirm against gross margin before launch.
basis.perSeatListPrice: Mid-point of Apollo's published paid tiers ($49 / $79 / $119 per seat per month, annual billing) and the ~$100-120/user/month estimates for Outreach; Skout is positioned as an AI GTM platform, so the Professional-tier price point is used.
basis.discountBands: Published approval frameworks cluster at ~10% rep, 15-20% manager, 25-35% VP/Finance, above ~35% CFO/CEO.
basis.dealSizeBands: 2026 benchmark segments: SMB under $10K, mid-market $25K-$75K, enterprise $200K+.

priceBook._note: Per-seat price per month, billed annually. Month-to-month billing carries a surcharge. One price book entry per billing currency; a deal's currency is fixed once a proposal is sent. USD is benchmarked; the other currencies are SUGGESTED regional prices, not benchmarked - Finance to confirm.

creditPacks._note: Credit packs stay as one-time Razorpay orders. Keep the existing pack definitions and prices from the billing code; only add a per-currency price per pack here.

approvals._note: Rules are evaluated together; every rule that matches adds its approver. The deal needs all of them. Percentages are discount off the price-book list price for the deal currency.

failedPayment._note: Applies to per-seat subscriptions. Day 0 = first failed charge. A failed credit-pack payment is simply not credited. Day numbers are calendar days. Align with Razorpay's actual retry/halted timing once confirmed.

seatChanges._note: Enable immediate proration only after confirming Razorpay subscription update/proration behaviour.
